title: Vibe coded my first android game - need your feedback!
author: business_warrior
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1tnrxln/video/dhtkne0pud3h1/player

  
Hi guys! I just vibe coded my first casual android game - Bamboo Slicers. The gameplay loop is pretty fun imo, you just cut bamboo, your sword grows, and you smash opponents with it, also added lots of random perks and events that happen so that you won’t get bored.  
  
For development I used Unity, Ivan Murzak MCP with Claude Code connected. Assets are paid assets from Unity Asset Store (very cheap ones though)  
  
Right now I really need some testers, because I want to be confident in the game’s quality before the release.  
  
If you are willing to help, please, play my game and give me some feedback, here’s the link, it’s already in Open Testing: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kuxomuxo.bambooslicers](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kuxomuxo.bambooslicers)  
  
For feedback you can use feedback form: [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe53GkHFwJIIuU9JMTdoNvPa8hzLFtcEUU8T01EHCrTqR4aDg/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=105396540687837492014](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe53GkHFwJIIuU9JMTdoNvPa8hzLFtcEUU8T01EHCrTqR4aDg/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=105396540687837492014)  
  
Or report bugs directly in settings, using “give feedback” option. Or just DM me / write a comment under this post.  
  
If you have any questions please let me know, I’m happy to share any knowledge and experience I have!
